text: In a cohomological spectral sequence, each new page is the cohomology of the current page with respect to $d_r$: $E_{r+1}^{p,q}=\ker(d_r^{p,q})/\mathrm{im}(d_r^{p-r,q+r-1})$.
explanation: True: this is the defining recursion of a spectral sequence, so each page is literally the cohomology of the previous one at the spot $(p,q)$. Repeatedly passing to cohomology is what makes the differentials eventually vanish and the pages stabilize to $E_\infty$.
